_note: Story script + shot list. img = assets/story/clay/.jpg, vo = audio/vo/.mp3 (missing files must be tolerated: fall back to showing the caption for a few seconds). who is the speaker label shown on the subtitle. Captions are subtitles of the spoken line only. Story: "Breathe Easy" (Mayor Pristine). Shot clips are assets/story/clay/be_.mp4 with their own lip-synced audio; vo is the fallback line.

in.cap: Friday at sundown, the judges come for my trophy. Thirty-one years, Salvatore. That box is gone by then… or you are.
Ohhh. That is a LOT of inventory.
Champ. Five thousand vapes. One Friday. And the Mayor wants my head. Get this town HOOKED.
Boss. I was BORN for this!

call.cap: Downtown, kid. Hook me five, and walk 'em back to the shop!

out.cap: They came back? They're coming BACK!

chapters.title: The Anthem
mission: THEN WALK 5 GRANDMAS TO CLOUD KINGZ

in.cap: Good morning, Coral Vista. Today, for your health, our town soprano will sing the anthem in the park. All day. Walking out would be… rude. Breathe easy.

call.cap: Nobody walks out on the opera lady mid-song. Win her over, and every grandma in that park is ours. Then walk me five!

out.cap: Kid! I sold out of mango! I've never sold out of ANYTHING!

chapters.title: Lungs of Steel
mission: THEN WALK 5 BROS TO CLOUD KINGZ

in.cap: Introducing Lungs of Steel, with our fitness ambassador, Prime. Real lungs breathe air. Breathe easy.

call.cap: Nobody on Muscle Beach breathes till Prime breathes first. Out-lung the big guy, and his boys'll follow you anywhere. Five, back to the shop!

out.cap: Two chains, kid. TWO. We're franchising.

in.cap: Effective immediately: curfew. Everyone indoors. An officer on every corner. Coral Vista is closed.
We're out of people, kid. …What about the cows?

call.cap: Thursday, kid. Two thousand left. She said people stay indoors. She didn't say nothin' about cows. Five. Yeah. Cows count.

out.cap: Is it weird I miss when nobody came in?

in.cap: Judges arrive at sundown. Detecto, our official mascot, will escort everyone… out. Breathe…

call.cap: Sundown, kid! Empty that box! And somebody shut up that smoke detector!

end.cap: Zero. You did it, kid… So, uh. I ordered fifty thousand.

clear.cap: That's the district, kid! Look at 'em all! LOOK at 'em!

nudge.cap: Kid, the other way! Follow the cloud!

hey.cap: Hey! Kid! You lost? Here's the deal.

back1.cap: Kid! Bring 'em back to the shop! Bring 'em HERE!

back2.cap: You got customers? Walk 'em over, kid! Cloud Kingz! I'm right here!

back3.cap: Kid, kid, kid! Don't leave 'em out there! Bring 'em to the store!

enough.cap: That's enough, kid! That's the whole order! Bring 'em home, I'm holding the door!

live._note: Sal's live reactions at the Cloud Kingz door as delivered customers walk in (audio only, no caption on screen). count[k-1] is said for the chapter's k-th delivery; alright opens a fresh batch.

districts._note: Game-world coordinates (x, z). Ocean is at -z (east on the map). See assets/clay/map_town.png and docs/story-bible.md.

shop._note: proposed vape shop block, replaces the downtown building at grid (0, +1)

lines._note: Short voice lines the bosses say in play (audio/vo/<key>.mp3); the caption shows under the crosshair while it plays.

diva_won.cap: Bravissima! BRAVISSIMA! Darling… does it come in MANGO?

diva_again.cap: Ah-ah-ah, darling. Not yet. Wait for the top of the phrase!

prime_intro.cap: Nobody breathes on my beach till PRIME breathes first. Lung set, bro. Three reps. Match me.

prime_won.cap: …Respect, king. RESPECT. Take the chain. Boys? We follow him now.

detecto_intro.cap: SMOKE DETECTED. I am DETECTO, official mascot of Cleanest Air in Florida, thirty-one years running. Everybody: EVACUATE.

detecto_sleep.cap: Sensor… full. Low… battery. Beep. Beep… goodnight.
